name: image-intake-wizard
description: guided intake, routing, and approval workflow for generated image requests. use when a user asks to create, generate, refine, brief, or prepare an image, illustration, concept visual, hero image, campaign visual, mockup, or visual prompt and the request needs composition, mood, brand, aspect ratio, audience, reference, or avoidance details before generation. route away when the actual deliverable is a figma design, diagram, frontend artifact, wordpress block-theme handoff, design qa review, brand guideline review, or written prompt only.
